caption:
Small Batch Brownies - ONLY 6 Ingredients
make this recipe this weekend and you will not regret it for a second! very little can go wrong and if you need any help or have any doubts, DM me :) 

in a microwave, melt 80 grams of dark chocolate + 40 grams of salted butter
in another bowl, add 80 grams brown sugar + 1 egg + 1/2 tsp vanilla essense and beat together - you can use a hand whisk if you feel like working your arm muscles else use an electric beater, your mix should be light and fluffy.
fold in the melted butter chocolate mix followed by 30 grams ap flour and finally 50-60 grams of chopped dark chocolate and an optional sprinkle of sea salt!

the perfect pan for this recipe is a 8” X 4” however if you want thicker brownies you can use a smaller pan :) 

bake at 180 degrees C for 15-20 minutes till you see your crinkle top forming and allow to cool

Brownies come out of the oven super fudgy so ideally leave them to cool for 2-3 hours, speed it up by popping in th fridge for 30 minutes :) 

Tips:
-use good quality dark chocolate, buy a 70% lindt chocolate bar for this recipe. the results justify the cost :)
